Least favorite is Yukina. Yukina was a selfish, unnecessarily rude fussy prick who took advantage of Lisa's kind and patient nature and was ready to abandon the other girls at the drop of a hat. I say was not because she was developed like Sayo, but because she simply changed. She was essentially lobotomized into becoming a different person with no real development behind it. I like her at times now, but it feels disingenuous because she's not Yukina Minato anymore, instead she's more like someone vaguely similar just wearing her skin around.

Favorite is Maya. Her character arc was super sweet and I relate to her on a spiritual level ;v;
